WITH eq_avg AS (
  SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humepct
  FROM scanenvironment
  GROUP BY equipref
),
ref AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humepct) AS overall_avg
  FROM eq_avg
),
above AS (
  SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humepct
  FROM eq_avg e
  CROSS JOIN ref r
  WHERE e.avg_humepct > r.overall_avg
),
grp AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humepct) AS group_mean
  FROM above
)
SELECT a.equipref,
       a.avg_humepct AS avg_humidity,
       a.avg_humepct - r.overall_avg AS exceeds_overall_avg,
       a.avg_humepct - g.group_mean AS diff_from_group_mean
FROM above a
CROSS JOIN ref r
CROSS JOIN grp g
WHERE r.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND g.group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
